description: Shorti(쇼티) for «what should I shoot this week?» or «이번 주 뭐 찍지?». Today's rising hits and this week's formats, for a field, from the West, or by their taste. `category` narrows it ('food'). Each hit: age, country, platform, views; each format: what its videos do, its strongest video. `field`: a profession or shop in their words; `lens`: radar or mine. Signed in, their week leads.

category.description: The creator's niche, when they have one.

field.description: Their profession, team, shop or field in their own words (피부과, 카페, 브랜드팀).

lang.description: 'en': Shorti's own English; never translate its Korean.

lens.description: radar: formats breaking out in the West no Korean video holds yet; mine: by their stated taste.

platform.description: Only formats with videos on this platform.

state.description: With radar: none in Korea yet, or the first ones.

name: shorti_what_to_shoot

for_you.description: true when a signed-in reader's own week leads the list

refusal.description: why nothing was answered, by name

today.description: today's rising hits, newest first, the asker's side first

week.description: the Monday (KST) the week's picks are fixed on

title: What to shoot this week
